\[
\begin{gathered}
\begin{aligned}
&\text{A: } z_{\min} < z_{\text{med}} < z_{\max} \;\Rightarrow\; \text{go to B, else grow } S_{xy} \text{ up to } 7, \text{ then output } z_{\text{med}} \\
&\text{B: } I_{\text{out}}(x,y) = \begin{cases} z_{xy} & z_{\min} < z_{xy} < z_{\max} \\ z_{\text{med}} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases}
\end{aligned}
\end{gathered}
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(z_{\min}, z_{\text{med}}, z_{\max}\): Min, median and max of the window
- \(z_{xy}\): The value of the pixel (x, y)
- \(S_{xy}\): The current window around (x, y)

z_min, z_med and z_max are the min, median and max of the current window S_xy, and z_xy is the pixel. Stage A checks that the median is not an impulse itself. If it is, the window grows by 2 and stage A runs again. Stage B keeps the pixel when it lies strictly between the min and the max, so it is not an impulse, and replaces it by the median otherwise.
